messages.content: The Art Institute entry was moved up to 9:00 Sunday, and now everyone wants lunch nearby afterward. Can you redo the practical schedule for the whole weekend?

Yes. I’ll keep the Friday arrival, Saturday 6:00 p.m. birthday dinner in Lincoln Square, and Monday evening flight, then adjust Sunday around the earlier museum entry. What time is the return flight Monday?
It departs O’Hare at 7:35 p.m. We’ll leave our bags at the Fairfield after checkout.

For Friday, follow the existing late-arrival plan and expect to reach the Fairfield around 11:15–11:35 p.m. Saturday, leave the hotel at 4:50 p.m. Walk to the Red Line at Grand, transfer to the Brown Line at Fullerton, and continue to Western. That should put you in Lincoln Square around 5:35, leaving about 25 minutes before dinner.
Good. What is realistic for Sunday now? We should meet the family before the 9:00 entry, not at the door right at nine.

Finish breakfast by 7:45 and leave the hotel at 8:05. A cab or rideshare is the simplest option that early and should reach the Art Institute around 8:20–8:30. Meet the family outside by 8:30, allowing time for security and ticket scanning. After the visit, a 12:15 lunch reservation within a short walk would work well if you expect about three hours in the museum.
Lunch will be at 12:30 at The Gage. They already made the reservation. Now work out Monday, including going back for the bags.

Check out by 11:00 a.m. and leave both bags with the Fairfield. Plan to return to the hotel by 3:45 p.m.; that gives you time to retrieve them and handle any delay at the desk. Leave the hotel no later than 4:05, walk to Clark/Lake, and take the Blue Line to O’Hare. You should arrive around 5:00–5:15, a little over two hours before the 7:35 departure.
So is there anything else I actually need to reserve or change?

No required booking remains. Flights, the shared king room, Saturday dinner, Sunday 9:00 a.m. museum entry, and the 12:30 p.m. lunch are all set; Monday luggage storage is already noted. Saturday CTA travel and Sunday’s ride to the museum can be paid as you go. The only practical actions are to confirm the museum’s opening entrance, share the 8:30 meeting time with the family, and be back at the Fairfield by 3:45 Monday.
